turns.merchant: Why was my lavender massage oil disapproved?
turns.reply:
You have **1 disapproved product** due to a restricted product policy issue. You have **0 products with limited-reach warnings**.

* **Hemp Extract Massage Oil, Lavender, 100 ml** (ID: `HG-040`): Mentions "Hemp Extract", which falls under restricted products.

### Why this happened
According to [CBD and other unapproved substances](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/6165956), products containing cannabidiol (CBD) or listed under unapproved substances are not allowed in Shopping ads or free listings. This is a policy decision, not a data problem, so it cannot be fixed by editing product details.

### What you can do
If you believe this product was flagged incorrectly and you want to disagree with the decision, an appeal is possible. According to [Requesting a review or appealing a decision](https://support.google.com/merchants/answer/13585221), you may only get one chance to disagree before a waiting period starts. 

Please let me know if you would like to submit an appeal to a specialist, or if you have any other questions!
